forms.alt: 个-especially in the possessive usage,兮-Hokkien and Teochew; possessive particle, 的-Taiwanese Hokkien; possessive particle, ㄟ-Taiwanese Hokkien; possessive particle,…

glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 亻 (= 人) (“person”) + phonetic 固.
s_page_origin: Variant of 箇 (“bamboo stalk”). Half of 竹 (“bamboo”). A variant is 亇. Compare.
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 個; s_page_origin explains the simplified 个.
